nodes.name: canvas-design-system.md
nodes.summary: Canvas Design System reference covering design philosophy approach (2 phases: philosophy creation, visual expression), 4 core principles (Visual Communication First, Minimal Text Integration, Expert Craftsmanship, Systematic Patterns), 5 design movement examples (Concrete Poetry, Chromatic Language, Analog Meditation, Organic Systems, Geometric Silence), implementation guidelines, multi-page design systems, execution checklist, quality standards, refinement process (3 passes), output format, and use cases.

nodes.name: shadcn-accessibility.md
nodes.summary: shadcn/ui Accessibility Patterns reference covering foundation on Radix UI primitives, keyboard navigation (focus management, dialog/modal, dropdown/menu, command palette), screen reader support (semantic HTML, ARIA labels, SR-only text, live regions), form accessibility (labels, errors, required fields, fieldset/legend), component-specific patterns (Accordion, Tabs, Select, Checkbox/Radio, Alert), color contrast, focus indicators, motion/animation, testing checklist, and tools.

nodes.name: shadcn-components.md
nodes.summary: shadcn/ui Component Reference with installation guide and comprehensive component catalog: Form & Input (Button, Input, Form with React Hook Form + Zod, Select, Checkbox, Radio Group, Textarea, Switch, Date Picker), Layout & Navigation (Card, Tabs, Accordion, Navigation Menu), Overlays & Dialogs (Dialog, Drawer, Popover, Toast, Command, Alert Dialog), Feedback & Status (Alert, Progress, Skeleton), Display Components (Table, Avatar, Badge).

nodes.name: shadcn-theming.md
nodes.summary: shadcn/ui Theming & Customization reference covering dark mode setup (Next.js App Router, Vite), CSS variable system, color format (HSL), Tailwind configuration, 3 color customization methods (CSS variables, theme generator, multiple themes), component customization (variants, styles, className overrides), base color presets, style variants, radius customization, and best practices.

nodes.name: tailwind-customization.md
nodes.summary: Tailwind CSS Customization reference covering @theme directive, color customization (custom palette, semantic colors), typography customization (custom fonts, font sizes), spacing customization, custom utilities, custom variants, layer organization, @apply directive, plugins (official and custom), configuration examples (complete config, dark mode, content configuration, safelist), and best practices.

nodes.name: tailwind-responsive.md
nodes.summary: Tailwind CSS Responsive Design reference covering mobile-first approach, breakpoint system, responsive patterns (layout, visibility, typography, spacing, width), common responsive layouts (sidebar, card grid, hero, navigation), max-width queries, range queries, container queries, custom breakpoints, responsive state variants, best practices (6 principles), common responsive utilities (display, position, order, overflow), and testing checklist.

nodes.name: tailwind-utilities.md
nodes.summary: Tailwind CSS Utility Reference with comprehensive coverage of layout utilities (display, flexbox, grid, positioning, z-index), spacing utilities (padding, margin, space-between, spacing scale), typography (font size, weight, alignment, line height, combined, transform, decoration, overflow), colors (text, background, scale, opacity, gradients), borders (width, color, radius, style), shadows (regular, colored), width/height, arbitrary values, aspect ratio, overflow, opacity, cursor, and user select.
